title: No-escalation vector
description: Values a setting-up device may hand out compared with its own effective values (docs/setup.md, No escalation). cases: an ordered rule along its order (tools/profiles_ref.py looser). key_cases: control_path by key level after the platform mapping, none < read_only < full (key_looser): new and mine are effective control_path and remote_access values. looser = not offered. tools/validate.py recomputes every case.

rule.description: An ordered rule other than control_path (control_path is compared by key level, key_cases).

new.description: Effective value the new device would get (on its platform).

mine.description: Effective value of the setting-up device.

expected_looser.description: true = not offered (more than the setting-up device has).

new.description: Effective values of the new device on its platform (a TV or watch: hub is already checked).

mine.description: Effective values of the setting-up device.
